title: Time Of My Life (TOML)
short_description: Product modernization, accessibility enhancements, natural voice speech integration, secure cloud infrastructure, and multi-platform launch (Apple App Store, Google Play Store, and iPad) for the TOML mobile application.

description.overview: TOML was a functional application, but usability, accessibility, and infrastructure gaps were affecting the overall user experience. We executed a comprehensive upgrade focusing on usability, accessibility, infrastructure, branding, and multi-platform launch readiness across iOS, Android, and iPad.

sections.title: Application Usability & Accessibility Enhancements
points: Refined audio playback behavior for consistent playback across sessions
Improved task progress persistence across user sessions
Enhanced profile management and activity configurations
Optimized safety alerts and introduced automatic text-to-speech accessibility
Replaced default robotic voice with natural, human-like voice speech
Modernized visual identity using client-provided color theme and branding guidelines

sections.title: Cloud Infrastructure, Security & Quality Assurance
points: Established secure cloud infrastructure with dedicated staging and production environments
Implemented server security best practices including SSL, firewall protection, and secure credential management
Configured automated database backups and real-time system health monitoring
Performed comprehensive end-to-end functional, system, and regression testing

sections.title: Multi-Platform Launch & Store Compliance
points: Managed complete release lifecycle for Apple App Store, Google Play Store, and iPad platform
Updated in-app subscription system to comply with latest Apple and Google store policies
Handled submission, store review process, compliance checks, and feedback resolution
Ensured smooth approval and successful public availability across all stores

challenge.overview: The TOML application required a comprehensive upgrade before public release to resolve user experience, voice clarity, progress persistence, security, and app store compliance challenges.
details: Inconsistent audio playback behavior and progress tracking continuity across user sessions
Default robotic text-to-speech reducing user engagement and accessibility quality
Need for dedicated staging and production environments with real-time monitoring and automated backups
Complex multi-platform store submissions requiring strict in-app subscription policy compliance

impact: Significantly improved user experience through smoother navigation and intuitive interactions
Enhanced accessibility with automatic voice guidance and natural voice playback
Delivered a modern, client-branded interface with a refreshed visual experience
Improved task continuity with persistent progress tracking across sessions
Strengthened platform security through SSL, firewall protection, secure credential management, and automated backups
Increased application reliability with dedicated production infrastructure and continuous monitoring
Successfully published and launched the application on Apple App Store, Google Play Store, and iPad platform

title: CredNation (Now Doberme)
short_description: Building and scaling a two-sided security marketplace from MVP to full production. A real-time platform connecting licensed security professionals with clients needing on-demand protection.

description.overview: Building and scaling a two-sided security marketplace from MVP to full production.

sections.title: Designed and engineered a full two-sided marketplace MVP
points: Client dashboards and job management tools
Clean, reliable backend built for speed and future expansion
Modular architecture ensuring rapid iteration without technical debt

sections.title: Launched the MVP quickly and positioned for funding
points: Delivered stable, investor-ready MVP fast enough for demo and early user onboarding
Founders secured funding at $12M valuation within one month of launch
Validated both product and execution approach

sections.title: Expanded platform into full production system
points: Took platform from MVP to robust, scalable V2
Implemented new UI/UX from design team
Improved match logic and job flow
Added features for guard and client operations
Modernized internal workflows for better UX

sections.title: Delivered smooth rebrand transition
points: Seamless migration from CredNation to Doberme
Technical alignment with new brand vision

challenge.overview: The founders needed a complete tech foundation built from scratch with two different user types requiring different workflows.
details: No existing tech foundation - entire platform had to be designed, architected, and engineered from scratch
Two different user types requiring different workflows - guards needed onboarding, verification, scheduling; clients needed booking and management
Had to be investor-ready MVP yet stable and scalable for long-term growth
Any delay risked investor confidence and market entry timing

impact: Clear product-market validation - MVP helped secure significant early valuation and fueled investor confidence
Stable, scalable V2 - production build handled complex two-sided workflows without performance issues
Professional-grade user experience - updated UI combined with improved flows created polished, trustworthy platform
Faster operations - workflows previously manual became automated, improving efficiency
Strong technical foundation for growth - architecture supports new features and future expansion
Smooth rebrand rollout - transition happened without downtime or user friction
Fully functional, high-stability marketplace capable of scaling across states
